note: quest_db.yml with its imports for the mode, as QuestDatabase::parseBodyNode loads it, by Id. time_limit is absent without a TimeLimit. {seconds} is a TimeLimit with '+', the seconds solve_time adds without daylight saving: the quest ends that long after it starts. {at} is one without '+', read as split_exact_quest_time: the quest ends at the next time of day at, in seconds after midnight on the server's clock, and days more days later, or on the next weekday at that time (quest_time). targets are at most MAX_QUEST_OBJECTIVES (3), in order. A target with mob counts kills of that monster on any map. A target without mob counts every kill that passes its filters: min_level and max_level (0 or absent for none; max_level alone makes min_level 1), race, size and element (absent for all), location (absent for every map; a map the map server does not load counts everywhere, as map_mapindex2mapid gives -1), and mobs, the MapMobTargets that are true. map_name is the text the quest window shows. drops are the item drops a kill gives while the quest is active, to the player's inventory: mob is null for every monster, count is 1 for an item that does not stack, and rate is out of 10000. skipped lists the Ids of entries that parseBodyNode refused.
